title: Adventure tools
description: Adventure tools data pack. Extremely simple data pack that gives you access to commands that give you tools that can break certain blocks in adventure mode. Also works with the mod Simplest Hammers and Simplest Paxels.
body:
Adventure tools data pack. Extremely simple data pack that gives you access to commands that give you tools that can break certain blocks in adventure mode. Also works with the mod Simplest Hammers and Simplest Paxels. Doesn't include gold tier or wooden tier because I'm lazy and I'm planning to use those personally.

/functions will show the auto fill suggestions where you can get all the tools.
